prompts.B1_low: Locked-off tripod shot of a plain light-grey wooden table against a soft neutral studio background, even diffuse daylight, no shadows. A single matte red ball rests on the table at the left quarter of the frame. The ball rolls slowly to the right, a short distance, and comes to rest near the left third of the table early in the shot, then stays completely still. No camera movement. Audio: quiet room tone, one soft wooden rolling sound, then silence.
prompts.B2_med: A pale woman in her early thirties with a short black bob haircut, thin silver hoop earrings, faint freckles, wearing an oversized rust-orange wool coat over a charcoal turtleneck. She stands at a weathered wooden counter in a small sunlit kitchen, slowly stirring a copper pot of soup with a wooden spoon. Late-afternoon light falls through a window to her left, dust motes in the beam. The camera pushes in slowly from a medium shot to a medium close-up; she tastes the soup and smiles slightly. Natural handheld micro-motion throughout. Audio: gentle simmering, the wooden spoon tapping the copper pot, a quiet kitchen fan hum, soft piano notes from a radio in the next room.
prompts.B3_high: Locked-off tripod shot of a plain light-grey wooden table against a soft neutral studio background, even diffuse daylight, no shadows. A single matte red ball rests on the table at the left quarter of the frame. The ball rolls briskly from left to right across the whole table, crossing the full width of the frame, and comes to rest at the right quarter of the table just before the shot ends. No camera movement. Audio: quiet room tone, a sustained wooden rolling sound that travels from left to right and settles as the ball stops.
prompts.B4_naive_low: A static camera shot of a matte red ball rolling slowly from the left side of a plain grey table, stopping near the left third, then staying still.
prompts.B5_naive_med: A woman in an orange wool coat stirs a pot of soup at a kitchen counter in warm afternoon light while the camera slowly pushes in.
prompts.B6_naive_high: A static camera shot of a matte red ball rolling briskly across the whole width of a plain grey table from left to right, stopping at the right quarter.
